title: Chronicle Android Raw Data Preprocessing App
description: Dual-engine (browser + desktop Python) preprocessing instrument for Chronicle Android usage-events data: app-usage and screen-usage session reconstruction under a versioned 55-option contract, byte-exact cross-engine parity, golden-scenario locking, and per-run PROV provenance sidecars. Includes the LinkML/OWL/SHACL research ontology generated from the same source of truth.
